clips.speaker: Felix Wong
clips.title: Hedge Iris董事：DeepSeek发动价格战，智谱难以提价

subtitles.en: For 5.2, they left the prices the same. So what I'm trying to say here is, it still costs 5x more to run a task with Tsupu's GLM 5.2 model than if you had done it with deepseek V4 pro
subtitles.zh: 对于5.2，他们维持价格不变。所以我想说的是，使用智谱GLM 5.2运行任务的成本仍是DeepSeek V4 Pro的5倍。

subtitles.en: and the intelligence levels between these two models aren't that far off. So then the bigger picture question you need to ask yourself if your engineer and developer is, what is good enough to get the work done?
subtitles.zh: 而这两个模型的智能水平相差不大。所以工程师和开发者需要问自己：什么才是完成工作的足够好的选择？
en_highlights: intelligence levels aren't that far off

subtitles.en: Do I really need to have the most frontier, most intelligent model out there if I'm paying at least 5x that price?
subtitles.zh: 如果我要支付至少5倍的价格，我真的需要最前沿、最智能的模型吗？

subtitles.en: So I'm just asking you, because JB Morgan had a very interesting note this week saying that out of all the sort of AI players out there in China, they still think Japan has the most pricing power.
subtitles.zh: 我问你，因为摩根大通本周指出，在中国所有AI玩家中，他们仍认为智谱拥有最强的定价权。

subtitles.en: I mean, what's the counter-argument to that? So by pricing power, they're talking about what they're priced right now on input and output. But what I'm saying is, that's all rear view mirror.
subtitles.zh: 对此有什么反驳？他们说的定价权是指当前的输入输出价格。但我要说，那都是后视镜。

subtitles.en: I'm looking at current dynamics today, particularly again with the release of deepseek V4 a couple months ago, is Tsupu able to raise their token prices because of what they have done with the full stack model portfolio?
subtitles.zh: 我看的是当前动态，尤其是DeepSeek V4发布几个月后，智谱能否凭借其全栈模型组合提高token价格？

subtitles.en: And my answer is no, because deepseek basically created a cost-bottom. And they're basically initiating this hugely damaging LLM price for it.
subtitles.zh: 我的答案是不能，因为DeepSeek基本上创造了一个成本底线，他们正在发起极具破坏性的LLM价格战。

subtitles.en: And I think it hurts everybody, except deepseek.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这伤害了所有人，除了DeepSeek。

clips.speaker_context: Managing Director of Global Tech Research at Hedge Iris Management

clips.speaker: Felix Wong
clips.title: Hedge Iris董事：DeepSeek抢占token份额，蒸馏技术成新挑战

subtitles.en: So we have a lot of evidence out there that deepseek, through their new entry into V4, they're taking a lot of token share. I don't see that changing, even with Tsupu catching up, with frontier models like Clawed and GPT, at least on the intelligent level, but watch closely the pricing.
subtitles.zh: 我们有大量证据表明，DeepSeek通过V4抢占了大量token份额。即使智谱在智能水平上追赶Claude和GPT，我认为这种情况也不会改变，但要密切关注定价。
en_highlights: taking a lot of token share

subtitles.en: The token pricing did not go up. And does that same thesis apply to, I mean, if deepseek is, I mean, just to use that phrase, the deepseek moment of this is the Chinese model, it's low cost, you don't have to be at the front here of what's available technologically speaking.
subtitles.zh: token价格没有上涨。同样的逻辑是否适用于其他AI公司？DeepSeek时刻意味着中国模式低成本，你不需要站在技术最前沿。

subtitles.en: Does your thesis apply to other AI plays then? That the same pricing power isn't actually there. It applies to pretty much all of the other LLM models, including many Macs, including Quinn, even Tencent.
subtitles.zh: 你的论点是否适用于其他AI公司？同样的定价权并不存在。它适用于几乎所有其他LLM模型，包括许多Mac、Quinn，甚至腾讯。

subtitles.en: So I think this is a very important moment here. And people are trying to digest it, but what I'm trying to say is deepseek definitely have structure advantages, particularly with the one key infrastructure that allowed them the price as low as they are able to.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这是一个非常重要的时刻。人们正在消化它，但我想说的是DeepSeek确实拥有结构性优势，尤其是关键基础设施使其能够定价如此之低。

subtitles.en: Another challenge I want to mention about this company that I don't think is well understood is distillation. So you may have heard Fable 5, Mythos 5 being banned temporarily or permanently.
subtitles.zh: 另一个我认为未被充分理解的挑战是蒸馏技术。你可能听说过Fable 5、Mythos 5被暂时或永久禁止。

subtitles.en: We don't know yet from anthropic. Why does this matter to the Tsupu thesis?
subtitles.zh: 我们还不清楚Anthropic的情况。这对智谱的论点有何影响？

clips.speaker_context: Managing Director of Global Tech Research at Hedge Iris Management

clips.speaker: Felix Wong
clips.title: Hedge Iris董事：智谱估值87倍，目标价仅40美元

subtitles.en: So Tsupu usually has been coined by many analysts as the anthropic of China. I'm not so sure about that. I think there are some similarities on B2B, but we're keeping an eye on what's happening with anthropic.
subtitles.zh: 许多分析师称智谱为中国的Anthropic。我不太确定。在B2B方面有一些相似之处，但我们正在关注Anthropic的情况。

subtitles.en: If you limit their best performing model, people are saying, well, that makes Tsupu a lot more competitive because they're almost as good as the most frontier models out there.
subtitles.zh: 如果限制其最佳模型，人们会说这使智谱更具竞争力，因为它们几乎与最前沿的模型一样好。

subtitles.en: So that's the alternative. So what I would say is the US government may be doing this to control distillation. So in the future, model releases, frontier model releases from both China and the US will probably slow down a lot because of these changes in distillation.
subtitles.zh: 所以这是一种替代方案。我认为美国政府可能是在控制蒸馏技术。未来，中美两国的前沿模型发布可能会因此大幅放缓。

subtitles.en: Okay. What does this mean for the stock feelings? Because the lock up period expires pretty soon for some of these stocks. How much selling pressure are you expecting now? And what is fair value you think for Jirupu now?
subtitles.zh: 这对市场情绪意味着什么？因为一些权益资产的锁定期即将到期。你预计会有多大的抛售压力？你认为智谱的公允价值是多少？

subtitles.en: So my fair value is actually only around $407. The way I reach there is if you put a 15 times EV.AR multiple on 2028 numbers or 20 times EV.
subtitles.zh: 我的公允价值实际上只有大约40美元。我是通过给2028年数据15倍EV/AR或20倍EV得出的。

subtitles.en: The sales figure for 2028. Why am I using these numbers? Again, I'm using an anthropic and open AI as sort of a guide on what is reasonable valuation for pure model, pure LL model company.
subtitles.zh: 2028年的营收数据。为什么用这些数字？我以Anthropic和OpenAI作为纯LLM公司合理估值的参考。

subtitles.en: Now put this into perspective and anthropic, trailing valuation for EV, the AR is right now 21 times, Jirupu is trading at 87 times EV, the AR.
subtitles.zh: 对比来看，Anthropic的EV/AR倍数是21倍，而智谱是87倍。

clips.speaker_context: Managing Director of Global Tech Research at Hedge Iris Management

clips.speaker: Felix Wong
clips.title: Hedge Iris董事：智谱估值极端，建议谨慎

subtitles.en: And that's for next year. So we're looking at four valuation versus Jirupu valuation. That's how extreme where Jirupu has gone up.
subtitles.zh: 这是明年的数据。所以我们看到的是4倍估值对比智谱的估值，这就是智谱涨幅的极端程度。

subtitles.en: I understand it's a huge AI beneficiary right now. And a lot of investors are parting like 1999, but I'm not sure that party will last much, much longer.
subtitles.zh: 我理解它现在是AI的巨大受益者，很多投资者像1999年那样狂欢，但我不确定这场派对能持续多久。

subtitles.en: There are some lock-ups. Feel it? Yeah, cover, side. Yes. No, no, that's true. The lock-up period is coming up. So there is an additional factor to consider in terms of selling.
subtitles.zh: 还有一些锁定期。感觉到了吗？是的，没错。锁定期即将到来，所以抛售方面还有一个额外因素需要考虑。

subtitles.en: Well, my simple question is what would make you change your mind? And if you don't like this stock, is there any other company within the Chinese ecosystem that you like that you think is, apart from deep seek, of course, in the public markets which you think investors should favor instead?
subtitles.zh: 我的简单问题是，什么会让你改变看法？如果你不喜欢这只权益资产，在中国生态系统中，除了DeepSeek，还有哪些公开市场上的公司你认为投资者应该青睐？

subtitles.en: So at the moment, we're actually kind of cautious on China Internet. And my go-to proxy for anthropic in China is actually Keemi.
subtitles.zh: 目前我们对中国的互联网板块持谨慎态度。我在中国看好的Anthropic对标其实是Keemi。

clips.title: UBP经济学家：美联储若删除“额外”一词，或暗示加息

subtitles.en: We are in the middle of this week here. We got through what it comes to the Bank of Japan. As expected, it did high rates to 1% yesterday.
subtitles.zh: 本周已过半。日本央行如预期加息至1%。

subtitles.en: It was a whole from the RBA also expected. We're at the hump day, and really it is Fed day here today, and this is really going to be the big one.
subtitles.zh: 澳洲联储也如预期。周三关键日，今日美联储决议才是重头戏。

subtitles.en: Ahead, of course, the BOE, the SP, we got the eye coming up here as well, so certainly there's going to be a lot.
subtitles.zh: 接下来还有英国央行、标普等，事件密集。

subtitles.en: The key thing to watch though, I think, is to look at some of the statements there from the last one to see, and the word today of the day is additional, right?
subtitles.zh: 关键看上次声明中的措辞，今日关键词是“额外”。

subtitles.zh: 上次会议他们写道：考虑额外调整联邦基金利率目标区间的幅度和时机。
